lines.v3: [steady, and it is the hardest thing she says] Whatever you send. [beat] Send all of him. Not the useful half. [beat] He chained them together so that nobody could do to him what he did to Willi Kroll. [beat] If you unchain them to make him a martyr, you have learned nothing tonight.

lines.text: Frau Vogt. You have been redacting this collection for four years. I have seen the version history. Nine hundred entries, all of them family names, all of them yours to approve.
lines.v3: [not unkind, but not stopping] Frau Vogt. You have been redacting this collection for four years. I have seen the version history. [beat] Nine hundred entries. All of them family names. All of them yours to approve.

lines.text: Yes.
lines.v3: [flat] Yes.

lines.text: Why?
lines.v3: [simply] Why?

lines.text: Because in nineteen eighty-three a woman in Adlershof read a list into a microphone eleven times, and she was not paid, and she was not asked, and she was told what would happen to her daughter if she declined.
lines.v3: [very level, the levelness is enormous effort] Because in nineteen eighty-three, a woman in Adlershof read a list into a microphone eleven times. [beat] And she was not paid. And she was not asked. [beat] And she was told what would happen to her daughter if she declined.

lines.text: ...Ilse Vogt.
lines.v3: [quietly] ...Ilse Vogt.

lines.text: Ilse Vogt. She died in two thousand and four, in Pankow, having never once told me what she did. I found out from a card index. I took this posting fourteen months later.
lines.v3: [precise, unbearable] Ilse Vogt. [beat] She died in two thousand and four, in Pankow. Having never once told me what she did. [beat] I found out from a card index. [beat] I took this posting fourteen months later.

lines.text: So yes. I have been removing names. I have not removed one fact, one date, or one crime. I have removed the addresses of frightened people. If that ends my career, then a great many people in this story have paid more for less.
lines.v3: [hardening back into procedure, which is her armour] So yes. I have been removing names. [beat] I have not removed one fact. One date. Or one crime. [beat] I have removed the addresses of frightened people. [beat] If that ends my career, then a great many people in this story have paid more, for less.

lines.text: [very quietly] I did not know she had a daughter.
lines.v3: [very quietly, and it is the first true thing he has said] [long pause] I did not know she had a daughter.

lines.text: You had her voice for forty years, Herr Nagel. You never once wondered whose it was.
lines.v3: [flat, and it lands like a slap] You had her voice for forty years, Herr Nagel. [beat] You never once wondered whose it was.

lines.text: Finding entered. Ulrich Nagel, insertion of a covert instruction into a civil broadcast. Gene Dorsey, unauthorised disclosure, March nineteen eighty-three. Willi Kroll, exonerated of espionage, unlawfully killed. Transmitting the redacted file.
lines.v3: [formal, fast, hands shaking somewhere under the voice] Finding entered. [beat] Ulrich Nagel. Insertion of a covert instruction into a civil broadcast. [beat] Gene Dorsey. Unauthorised disclosure, March nineteen eighty-three. [beat] Willi Kroll. Exonerated of espionage. Unlawfully killed. [beat] Transmitting the redacted file.

lines.text: Bundespolizei took the courier on the east platform at four minutes past. The case held a one-time pad and a phone with one number in it. The number is disconnected. It has been disconnected since before the arrest.
lines.v3: [flat] Bundespolizei took the courier on the east platform at four minutes past. The case held a one-time pad, and a phone with one number in it. [beat] The number is disconnected. [beat] It has been disconnected since before the arrest.

lines.text: Of course it is. You have cut one wire out of a switchboard, Examiner. Do not mistake that for the end of the exchange. But it was the correct wire, and it has been forty-three years, and I find I am not sorry.
lines.v3: [dry, tired, and something almost like warmth] Of course it is. [beat] You have cut one wire out of a switchboard, Examiner. Do not mistake that for the end of the exchange. [beat] But it was the correct wire. And it has been forty-three years. [beat] And I find I am not sorry.

lines.text: They will make him a villain by Thursday. Both of them. My father killed a frightened man at a border and then spent eight years posting the proof to a child, and there is no headline that holds both halves of that.
lines.v3: [exhausted, clear] They will make him a villain by Thursday. Both of them. [beat] My father killed a frightened man at a border, and then spent eight years posting the proof to a child. [beat] And there is no headline that holds both halves of that.

lines.text: But it is out, and it is whole, and Willi Kroll's sister is eighty-one and can read it tomorrow. That will do. That will have to do.
lines.v3: [steadying] But it is out. And it is whole. And Willi Kroll's sister is eighty-one, and can read it tomorrow. [beat] That will do. [beat] That will have to do.

lines.text: Examiner. Herr Nagel has sent one further file from custody. It is not evidence. He has marked it, in English, personal.
lines.v3: [hesitant, out of procedure for once] Examiner. [beat] Herr Nagel has sent one further file from custody. [beat] It is not evidence. He has marked it, in English: personal.

lines.text: Session four, nineteen eighty-one. Between takes. I never cut this one because there was nothing in it I could use. Frau Vogt, I am too old to apologise usefully. Take it anyway.
lines.v3: [quiet, no performance] Session four. Nineteen eighty-one. Between takes. [beat] I never cut this one, because there was nothing in it I could use. [beat] Frau Vogt. I am too old to apologise usefully. [beat] Take it anyway.

lines.text: Is it still running? It is still running. Oh - one moment - my daughter has a concert this evening and I have promised, so if we could possibly-
lines.v3: [warm, quick, alive, laughing, entirely unlike the station voice, slightly off-mic] Is it still running? [beat] It is still running. [beat] Oh - one moment - my daughter has a concert this evening, and I have promised, so if we could possibly-

lines.text: Yes. Sorry. Ready.
lines.v3: [composing herself, still smiling] Yes. Sorry. [beat] Ready.

lines.text: Wind, south south west, four. Cloud, broken. Visibility, three.
lines.v3: [and now flat, the station voice, the mask going back on] Wind, south south west, four. Cloud, broken. Visibility, three.

lines.text: One correction to the record. You released the file entire. At eleven minutes past, a woman in Schwerin rang this facility to ask why her mother's name is on the internet. I did not have an answer for her. I do not have one now.
lines.v3: [very quiet, wrecked] One correction to the record. [beat] You released the file entire. [beat] At eleven minutes past, a woman in Schwerin rang this facility, to ask why her mother's name is on the internet. [beat] I did not have an answer for her. [beat] I do not have one now.

lines.text: The window has closed. Nothing was transmitted. The finding is sealed under the continuity provision for ninety-nine years, which means all of us will be dead and so will anyone who cared.
lines.v3: [flat, hollow] The window has closed. Nothing was transmitted. [beat] The finding is sealed under the continuity provision, for ninety-nine years. [beat] Which means all of us will be dead. And so will anyone who cared.

lines.text: Herr Nagel was collected at his flat at twenty past. There will be no charge. There will be an arrangement. The courier was allowed to board.
lines.v3: [reciting, refusing to editorialise] Herr Nagel was collected at his flat at twenty past. [beat] There will be no charge. There will be an arrangement. [beat] The courier was allowed to board.

lines.text: You did the adult thing, Examiner, and nobody is ever going to tell you so. Four families went to bed tonight not knowing there was a decision about them. That's the whole job. That was always the whole job.
lines.v3: [gentle, grateful, and it is the most frightening thing he says] You did the adult thing, Examiner. And nobody is ever going to tell you so. [beat] Four families went to bed tonight not knowing there was a decision about them. [beat] That's the whole job. That was always the whole job.

lines.text: Gene, if you thank the examiner one more time I shall come to Virginia.
lines.v3: [icy] Gene. If you thank the examiner one more time, I shall come to Virginia.

lines.text: I have been given a copy. Personal use. Not to be reproduced. Forty years, and my inheritance is a file I am not allowed to show anyone.
lines.v3: [very quiet, no anger left] I have been given a copy. Personal use. Not to be reproduced. [beat] Forty years. [beat] And my inheritance is a file I am not allowed to show anyone.

lines.text: He killed a man to keep six names quiet and you have kept his name quiet to protect four more, and I cannot tell any longer whether that is the moral of the story or just the story repeating.
lines.v3: [level, and it is an accusation] He killed a man to keep six names quiet. [beat] And you have kept his name quiet, to protect four more. [beat] And I cannot tell, any longer, whether that is the moral of the story. [beat] Or just the story repeating.

lines.text: Examiner. The carrier is still up. There is no modulation on it. There has been no modulation for six minutes.
lines.v3: [quiet, uneasy] Examiner. The carrier is still up. [beat] There is no modulation on it. [beat] There has been no modulation for six minutes.

lines.text: It is simply open. As though something is waiting to see whether we will say anything at all.
lines.v3: [almost a whisper] It is simply open. [beat] As though something is waiting. To see whether we will say anything at all.

lines.text: The window is open. The transmission is going out and I cannot stop it from this room.
lines.v3: [fast, alarmed] The window is open. The transmission is going out. [beat] And I cannot stop it from this room.

lines.text: Achtung. Station four one seven. Wind, west, two. Cloud, overcast. Visibility, one. Pressure, one one four nine.
lines.v3: [flat, metrical] Achtung. Station four one seven. [beat] Wind, west, two. Cloud, overcast. Visibility, one. Pressure, one one four nine.

lines.text: Courier confirmed. Blue key destroyed. Glasshouse closed.
lines.v3: [flat, evenly spaced, mechanical] Courier confirmed. Blue key destroyed. Glasshouse closed.

lines.text: The courier boarded at four minutes past. The case was opened at Erkner and the pad had already been burned. The archive was seized at half past under the continuity provision. I am told my access ends at midnight.
lines.v3: [dead flat, reading a list of losses] The courier boarded at four minutes past. The case was opened at Erkner, and the pad had already been burned. [beat] The archive was seized at half past, under the continuity provision. [beat] I am told my access ends at midnight.

lines.text: You named a person. You had four minutes and a room full of recordings, and you named a person, because that is what everybody does. That is what my father did to Willi Kroll.
lines.v3: [quiet, and the quietness is worse than shouting] You named a person. [beat] You had four minutes, and a room full of recordings. And you named a person. [beat] Because that is what everybody does. [beat] That is what my father did to Willi Kroll.

lines.text: It is nineteen eighty-three again, and this time I watched it happen in real time, on a conference line, with the countdown showing. Good night, Examiner.
lines.v3: [bitter, exhausted] It is nineteen eighty-three again. [beat] And this time I watched it happen in real time. On a conference line. With the countdown showing. [beat] Good night, Examiner.

lines.text: Examiner - the station has not closed down. It is still transmitting. This is not in tonight's schedule. This is new material.
lines.v3: [sharp, frightened] Examiner - the station has not closed down. It is still transmitting. [beat] This is not in tonight's schedule. [beat] This is new material.

lines.text: Message follows. Review terminal, seven, four, one, nine. Examiner present. Examiner listening. Examiner logged.
lines.v3: [flat, unhurried, exactly as neutral as the numbers] Message follows. [beat] Review terminal. Seven. Four. One. Nine. [beat] Examiner present. Examiner listening. [beat] Examiner logged.

lines.text: The forecast is memory. Ends.
lines.v3: [flat] The forecast is memory. Ends.

lines.text: I have been looking at the wrong part of the signal all evening. I have been looking at the sound.
lines.v3: [slow, working it out live] I have been looking at the wrong part of the signal all evening. [beat] I have been looking at the sound.

lines.text: My father's entire discipline was that sound can be forged and structure cannot. So measure the gaps. Eighty-one, eighty-three, tonight.
lines.v3: [quick] My father's entire discipline was that sound can be forged, and structure cannot. [beat] So measure the gaps. Eighty-one. Eighty-three. Tonight.

lines.text: Three beats. Two beats. Five beats. In every authentic transmission, in the silence between the phrases, for forty-five years.
lines.v3: [flat, then unsteady] Three beats. Two beats. Five beats. [beat] In every authentic transmission. In the silence between the phrases. [beat] For forty-five years.

lines.text: Does three, two, five mean anything?
lines.v3: [carefully] Does three, two, five mean anything?

lines.text: The third of the second, nineteen seventy-five. It's my birthday, Frau Vogt. He signed forty-five years of transmissions with my birthday and no one on either side ever thought to check the parts where nobody was talking.
lines.v3: [holding it together by a thread] The third of the second, nineteen seventy-five. [beat] It's my birthday, Frau Vogt. [beat] He signed forty-five years of transmissions with my birthday. [beat] And no one, on either side, ever thought to check the parts where nobody was talking.
